name: Abaddon the Despoiler
oracle_text:
Trample
Mark of Chaos Ascendant — During your turn, spells you cast from your hand with mana value X or less have cascade, where X is the total amount of life your opponents have lost this turn.
blocked_sentences: Mark of Chaos Ascendant — During your turn, spells you cast from your hand with mana value X or less have cascade, where X is the total amount of life your opponents have lost this turn.

needs.what: a static that grants the cascade keyword to spells its controller casts from hand (during your turn, via condition is_your_turn), filtered by an affects_spells mana_value ceiling whose bound is a dynamic static value -- here life_lost_this_turn summed over opponents -- so each matching spell gets its own cascade trigger (702.85) that survives the source leaving
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cascade exists only as an op (cascade with max_mana_value), not in keywords, so neither the grant_keyword static nor cast_gains_keywords (which the loader restricts to cast_from_library_top) can give it to a spell; a spell_cast trigger on Abaddon running the cascade op is a different ability (it belongs to Abaddon, not the spell, and dies with it), and static_value_keys has no life_lost_this_turn to set the mana value ceiling
